people.nameZh: 阿爾弗雷多·巴爾多米爾

heading.zh-Hant: 生平概略：特拉的姻親與蒙特維多警察首長
heading.en: Background: Terra’s brother-in-law and Montevideo police chief

body.zh-Hant: 巴爾多米爾是總統加夫列爾·特拉的姻親（brother-in-law），特拉選他為可能的接班人。特拉於1933年政變時，他是蒙特維多警察首長。1938年大選中，特拉讓該黨提出兩名候選人，他得12.1萬票。
body.en: Baldomir was the brother-in-law of President Gabriel Terra, who chose him as his potential successor. He had been chief of police in Montevideo at the time of Terra’s 1933 coup. In the 1938 election he received 121,000 votes as one of the two candidates Terra had the party offer.

heading.en: 1942: postponing elections, dissolving Congress and constitutional reform

body.zh-Hant: 1942年2月21日，巴爾多米爾延後三月的選舉並解散國會，並號召舉行修憲公民投票以恢復選舉制度的正常運作。新憲法取消了參議院由1933年政變領導人（特拉與埃雷拉）分配的作法，恢復完整的憲政民主。
body.en: On 21 February 1942 Baldomir postponed the upcoming March elections and dissolved Congress, calling for a constitutional plebiscite to restore the normal functioning of the electoral system. The new constitution did away with the division of the Senate between the 1933 coup leaders, Terra and Herrera, and restored full constitutional democracy.

people.name: Carlos Eugenio Restrepo Restrepo
people.nameZh: 卡洛斯·歐亨尼奧·雷斯特雷波

body.zh-Hant: 雷斯特雷波1867年9月12日生，出身麥德林一個頗有聲望但家境清貧的家庭，在家鄉學習法律。他曾參與千日戰爭，1901至1902年任安蒂奧基亞大學校長，後來在該校任憲法學教授。
body.en: Carlos Eugenio Restrepo was born on 12 September 1867 into a prestigious but poor family in Medellín and studied law in his hometown. He served in the War of the Thousand Days and was rector of the University of Antioquia in 1901–1902; later he became professor of constitutional law there.

heading.en: Congress of 1909 and election as president in 1910

body.zh-Hant: 雷斯特雷波以保守黨身分當選1909年國會議員，強烈反對拉斐爾·雷耶斯的獨裁。這些資歷使他於1910年當選總統，是首位任滿全期的安蒂奧基亞人。他的共和聯盟（Unión Republicana）是追求兩黨合作的嘗試；1914年與美國談成湯姆森—烏魯蒂亞條約。
body.en: Elected as a Conservative to the Congress of 1909, Restrepo strongly opposed the dictatorship of Rafael Reyes. This won him election to the presidency in 1910, the first Antioquian to hold the office for a full term. His Unión Republicana was an effort at bipartisanship, and the Thomson-Urrutia Treaty with the United States was negotiated in 1914.

body.en: In 1930 he spoke for the presidential candidacy of the Liberal Enrique Olaya Herrera. Restrepo served Olaya as minister of interior (1930) and as ambassador to the Holy See (1931–1934).

body.zh-Hant: 諾羅尼亞1873年6月6日生於里約熱內盧，是陸軍少將曼努埃爾·穆尼斯·德諾羅尼亞之子。1887年3月進入海軍學校預科，1892年任海軍準尉（guarda-marinha）。
body.en: José Isaías de Noronha was born in Rio de Janeiro on 6 June 1873, the son of Major General Manuel Muniz de Noronha. He entered the preparatory course of the Naval School in March 1887 and became a guarda-marinha in 1892.

heading.en: 1923–1928: rear admiral, Naval School director and fleet commander

body.zh-Hant: 1923年4月升任少將（contra-almirante），同年5月至1925年1月主持海軍學校。1927年8月起任艦隊總司令（comandante-em-chefe da Esquadra），1928年11月請辭。
body.en: Promoted to rear admiral (contra-almirante) in April 1923, he directed the Naval School from May that year until January 1925. From August 1927 he was commander-in-chief of the Fleet, a post he asked to leave in November 1928.

body.zh-Hant: 1930年10月24日總統華盛頓·路易斯遭罷黜，成立臨時軍人執政團（junta），諾羅尼亞代表海軍，並兼任海軍部長。執政團於11月3日把權力交給瓦加斯；他留任瓦加斯臨時政府的海軍部長，並於12月17日辭職。
body.en: On 24 October 1930 President Washington Luís was deposed, and a provisional military junta was formed in which Noronha represented the Navy; he also took charge of the Navy Ministry. The junta handed power to Vargas on 3 November. Noronha was kept on in the Navy Ministry of the Provisional Government and resigned on 17 December.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、青年運動與新聞工作

body.zh-Hant: 漢森1885年10月28日生於馬爾默，在工人區長大，僅受四年學校教育便當信差。1903年他是社會民主青年聯盟的共同創辦人，1908至1909年任其主席；1904年起在《勞動報》（Arbetet）當記者，1917年接替布蘭廷任《社會民主報》（Social-Demokraten）總編輯。
body.en: Per Albin Hansson was born in Malmö on 28 October 1885 and grew up in a working-class district, taking a job as an errand boy after just four years of schooling. In 1903 he co-founded the Social Democratic Youth League and chaired it in 1908–1909; from 1904 he was a journalist at the paper Arbetet, and in 1917 he succeeded Hjalmar Branting as editor-in-chief of Social-Demokraten.

dets formand fra 1908 til 1909
Fra 1904 var Hansson journalist ved avisen Arbetet i Malmø

heading.zh-Hant: 國會議員、國防大臣與黨主席
heading.en: Riksdag member, defence minister and party chairman

body.zh-Hant: 漢森自1918年起為國會議員。他在社會民主黨政府中三度出任國防大臣：1920年、1921至1923年與1924至1926年。1925年布蘭廷去世後，他在相當反對聲中當選黨主席。
body.en: Hansson sat in the Riksdag from 1918. He was defence minister in Social Democratic governments in 1920, 1921–1923 and 1924–1926. After Branting’s death in 1925 he was elected party chairman despite considerable opposition.

citations.quote: Han var medlem af Riksdagen fra 1918 til sin død
blev forsvarsminister i de socialdemokratiske regeringer
Efter Brantings død i 1925
trods betydelig modstand valgt til partiformand

body.zh-Hant: 1932年經濟危機中，漢森出任社會民主黨少數政府的領導人，1933年與農民聯盟達成「危機協議」。1936年夏天其政府被農民聯盟政府取代，同年9月他再度組閣。1939年12月冬季戰爭爆發後他組成國家聯合政府，對外確保瑞典形式上、後來頗受爭議的中立。他於1946年10月5日在斯德哥爾摩逝世。
body.en: In 1932, in the midst of the economic crisis, Hansson became leader of a Social Democratic minority government, and in 1933 reached the so-called crisis settlement with the Agrarian League. His government was replaced by an Agrarian League government in summer 1936, but in September that year he formed a government again. After the outbreak of the Winter War in December 1939 he formed a national coalition government, and externally Sweden’s formal, later somewhat contested neutrality was secured. He died in Stockholm on 5 October 1946.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、律師生涯與共和黨活動
heading.en: Origins, law career and Republican Party activity

body.zh-Hant: 阿里亞加1840年7月8日生於法亞勒島的奧爾塔，1861年前往科英布拉攻讀法律，之後在里斯本執業律師。他是葡萄牙共和黨的黨員與領導人，1882年當選馬德拉選區議員，1890年3月再當選里斯本議員，1897年9月當選共和黨指導委員會（directório）主席。
body.en: Manuel de Arriaga was born in Horta on 8 July 1840; in 1861 he moved to Coimbra to study law and then began a career as a lawyer in Lisbon. A militant and leader of the Republican Party, he was elected deputy for Madeira in 1882 and for Lisbon in March 1890, and in September 1897 became president of the party’s directório.

heading.zh-Hant: 1910至1911年：總檢察長、科英布拉大學校長與制憲議員
heading.en: 1910–1911: Attorney-General, Rector of Coimbra and Constituent deputy

body.zh-Hant: 1910年10月5日共和國成立後，阿里亞加於10月16日被任命為共和國總檢察長，10月23日出任科英布拉大學校長，並於1911年2月辭去校長職務。1911年他當選制憲議會議員，並主持起草委員會與外交委員會。
body.en: After the republic was proclaimed on 5 October 1910, Arriaga was appointed Attorney-General of the Republic on 16 October and, on 23 October, Rector of the University of Coimbra, from which he resigned in February 1911. In 1911 he was elected deputy to the Constituent Assembly, chairing its Drafting and Foreign Affairs committees.

body.zh-Hant: 1911年8月24日，阿里亞加當選共和國總統，為葡萄牙共和國首任總統。不到四年內他任命了八屆政府；1915年1月他任命皮門塔·德卡斯特羅組閣，後者在3月禁止國會開議。5月4日國會在祕密會議中宣布二人不受法律保護；他於5月26日辭去總統職務。
body.en: On 24 August 1911 Arriaga was elected President of the Republic, the first President of the Portuguese Republic. In under four years he swore in eight governments; in January 1915 he named Pimenta de Castro to head the government, who on 4 March prevented parliament from opening. On 4 May parliament declared both outside the law in a secret session, and Arriaga resigned the presidency on 26 May.

body.zh-Hant: 1916年4月15日，他拒絕了授予他的特赦，同年5月出版《葡萄牙第一任共和國總統任內》。他於1917年3月5日在里斯本逝世。
body.en: On 15 April 1916 he refused the amnesty granted to him, and in May of that year he published a short report on his presidency, Na Primeira Presidência da República Portuguesa. He died in Lisbon on 5 March 1917.
